Switch keyboards with the AOSP picker

Use the Android style when apps ask for camera, location or other permissions. Turn this on and follow the LSPosed and root prompts. The module applies the change automatically, without restarting your phone.
No new permission dialog has been reported yet.
Approve the LSPosed prompt to add Permission Controller. If no prompt appears, check your notifications.
Permission Controller still needs to be added. Tap Continue setup, then approve the LSPosed and root prompts to apply the change automatically.
Permission Controller has been added. If you still see the old dialog, tap Continue setup and allow root access to reapply without restarting your phone.
Setup is not complete. Tap Continue setup to retry, or select Permission Controller in this module’s scope in LSPosed, then come back to continue setup.
LSPosed is not connected. Enable this module, then reopen this app. If it still cannot connect, select Permission Controller in the module’s scope manually and restart your phone.
Applying the change. If your root manager shows a prompt, allow this module to use root access.
Setup complete. The next time an app asks for camera, location or other permissions, it will use the Android dialog.
Root access has not been granted. Allow this module in your root manager, then tap Continue setup. You can also restart your phone to apply the change.
Waiting for root access or applying the change took too long. Check that your root manager allows this module, then tap Continue setup. You can also restart your phone to apply the change.
The change could not be applied automatically. Check that this module has root access, then tap Continue setup. You can also restart your phone to apply the change.
Try a panel before replacing its system shortcut.
The status bar and Quick Settings will briefly disappear. Grant root access the first time you restart.
Restart System UI to load the updated module. The status bar and Quick Settings will briefly disappear, and root access is required. You can also restart later using the button on the home screen.

Improve the Android device settings page and open it from device details buttons in Settings and Quick Settings. Turn this on, approve the LSPosed and root prompts, then reopen the device page.
Approve the LSPosed prompt to add Settings and Wireless Settings. If no prompt appears, check your notifications.
Settings and Wireless Settings need to be in the module’s scope. Tap Continue setup and follow the LSPosed and root prompts.
Settings and Wireless Settings have been added. Tap Continue setup to apply, then reopen the Bluetooth device page.
Setup is not complete. Tap Continue setup to retry, or select Settings and Wireless Settings in this module’s scope in LSPosed, then return here.
LSPosed is not connected. Enable this module and reopen this app. You can also select Settings and Wireless Settings in its scope manually, then restart your phone.
